title: Transcription factor binding process is the primary driver of noise in gene expression.
authors: Parab, Lavisha; Pal, Sampriti; Dhar, Riddhiman
one_liner_zh: 该文通过统计模型和随机模拟研究转录因子结合竞争与合作对基因表达噪声的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA结合过程但未聚焦三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属于广义TF-DNA结合机制研究，对本课题有间接启发。
abstract: Noise in expression of individual genes gives rise to variations in activity of cellular pathways and generates heterogeneity in cellular phenotypes. Phenotypic heterogeneity has important implications for antibiotic persistence, mutation penetrance, cancer growth and therapy resistance. Specific molecular features such as the presence of the TATA box sequence and the promoter nucleosome occupancy have been associated with noise. However, the relative importance of these features in noise regulation is unclear and how well these features can predict noise has not yet been assessed. Here through an integrated statistical model of gene expression noise in yeast we found that the number of regulating transcription factors (TFs) of a gene was a key predictor of noise, whereas presence of the TATA box and the promoter nucleosome occupancy had poor predictive power. With an increase in the number of regulatory TFs, there was a rise in the number of cooperatively binding TFs. In addition, an increased number of regulatory TFs meant more overlaps in TF binding sites, resulting in competition between TFs for binding to the same region of the promoter. Through modeling of TF binding to promoter and application of stochastic simulations, we demonstrated that competition and cooperation among TFs could increase noise. Thus, our work uncovers a process of noise regulation that arises out of the dynamics of gene regulation and is not dependent on any specific transcription factor or specific promoter sequence.
abstract_zh: 个体基因表达中的噪声导致细胞通路活性的变异，并产生细胞表型的异质性。表型异质性对抗生素持久性、突变外显率、癌症生长及治疗耐药性具有重要意义。特定的分子特征，如TATA盒序列的存在和启动子核小体占据率，已被认为与噪声相关。然而，这些特征在噪声调控中的相对重要性尚不清楚，且这些特征预测噪声的能力尚未被评估。在此，通过整合酵母中基因表达噪声的统计模型，我们发现基因的调控转录因子（TFs）数量是噪声的关键预测因子，而TATA盒的存在和启动子核小体占据率的预测能力较弱。随着调控转录因子数量的增加，协同结合的转录因子数量也随之上升。此外，调控转录因子数量的增加意味着转录因子结合位点的更多重叠，导致转录因子在结合启动子同一区域时产生竞争。通过对转录因子与启动子结合的建模及随机模拟的应用，我们证明了转录因子间的竞争与合作能增加噪声。因此，我们的工作揭示了一个源于基因调控动态的噪声调控过程，该过程不依赖于任何特定转录因子或特定启动子序列。
